description: This file defines the I18nController class which implements ReactiveController, managing internationalization subscription updates for a Lit component.

classes.name: I18nController
classes.description: A controller class for managing internationalization subscriptions within Lit components, implementing ReactiveController.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the controller and registers it with the host component.

methods.name: hostConnected
methods.description: Subscribes to internationalization updates and triggers component updates when changes occur.

methods.name: hostDisconnected
methods.description: Unsubscribes from internationalization updates when the component is disconnected.
